briefdescription.para: Flash configuration table of the supported flash devices.
Finds the flash configuration table index for a flash ID.

parameterdescription.para: JEDEC ID read from the flash.
Pointer to store the matching table index.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS if a matching entry is found.

briefdescription.para: Contains the flash configuration table and flash related defines.

detaileddescription.para: The file should be included in the example files and compiled along with the examples (*.c).
